property_summary: For any value v, a fresh contract's SetMinSum(v) succeeds and sets MinSum to v; the mutant permanently locks after the first non-reentrant call, so in any second call SetMinSum reverts and MinSum stays unchanged.
change_summary: Delete `locked_ = false;` from the nonReentrant_ modifier so the lock is never released and any second call to SetMinSum reverts, leaving MinSum unchanged (unlike the original which allows each non-reentrant call to succeed).
